is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles arabiensis (Abstract, page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (1014F), Vgsc L995S (1014S), and Vgsc V402L (402L) (Abstract, page 1; Methods, page 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 1 and 2 provide genotype counts/frequencies for An. coluzzii and An. arabiensis for the years 2011, 2015, and 2020 (page 4).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Goden village, Burkina Faso (Methods, page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original genotyping data from field-collected mosquitoes (Methods, page 3; Results, page 4).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the location as Goden village (12°25′ N, 1° 21′ W) in the central region of Burkina Faso (Methods, page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports data for specific collection years: 2011, 2015, and 2020 (Methods, page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper states these are new collections processed for this study, although they are part of larger entomological collections conducted in those years (Methods, page 3).

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in Tables 1 and 2 within the main text.

assessment.summary: This study analyzed the temporal trends of insecticide resistance markers (1014F, 1014S, 402L) in Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles arabiensis from Goden village, Burkina Faso, over a 10-year period (2011, 2015, 2020). It found divergent trends in resistance allele frequencies between the two species and high levels of co-occurrence of resistance mutations.
